title: Ticket workflow state
description: Machine-readable state of one ticket's workflow run. Lives at tickets/<ticket-id>/state.json in the ticket repo. Written by the state-writer hook, read by the orchestrator to resume at the right step, and by the future UI as its backend.

ticket_id.description: Issue key as used by the tracker, e.g. PROJ-1234 or gh-482.

ticket_source.description: Which tracker this ticket lives in. Decides which MCP server the orchestrator talks to.

code_repo.description: Identifier of the code repository this ticket is implemented in.

phase.description: Coarse zone. intake = steps 1-5, blocks = steps 6-9 per block, delivery = steps 10-12.

intake_step.description: Current step inside the intake zone, e.g. "3". Only meaningful while phase is intake.

as_is_base_commit.description: Commit of the ticket repo's main branch that the to-be branch was created from. The as-is-staleness hook compares this against current main to decide whether step 7.0 is required.

to_be_branch.description: Branch in the ticket repo holding the to-be architecture for this ticket.

knowledge.description: Path to knowledge.md in the ticket repo.

adrs.description: Paths to ADR files in the ticket repo.

c4_views.description: LikeC4 view ids relevant to this ticket. Used by the PR description and by the UI's diagram pane.

blocks.description: Independently plannable themes the ticket was split into in step 4.

claimed_components.description: LikeC4 element ids this block modifies. The block-overlap hook rejects a claim already held by another block: overlapping claims mean the blocks were never independent (jump 7 -> 4).

claimed_stubs.description: Contracts frozen in step 7.2. The stub-lock hook blocks edits to these during steps 8 and 9.

path.description: Path in the code repo holding the contract declaration (trait, interface, abstract class).

symbol.description: Name of the declared contract, e.g. OrderService.

fingerprint.description: sha256 of the declaration file's content as frozen in 7.2.

shared_file.description: True when contract and implementation live in the same file, so the whole file cannot be locked. The hook then warns instead of blocking; see the stub-lock hook.

consultations.description: Every consultation point, open or answered. Addressable objects rather than terminal text, so the UI can render them and they double as an audit log.

block.description: Block id, or null for ticket-wide consultations in the intake and delivery zones.

jump_log.description: Every jump back to an earlier step, including the ones triggered by PR feedback. Mirrored into knowledge.md as prose.
